name: Data Analyzer: Every deployment template in the repository passes the secret-safety check
objective: Proves that each deployment template file (including private local copies when present) has no secret values or secrets lists that could wipe live secrets. Runs once per template file found.
precondition: Offline; the checker runs over every template in deploy/aca (private local copies only if present on the machine).

steps.action: Run the safety check on each template's text.
steps.expected: The checker returns no problems for every file.

name: Data Analyzer: The safety check rejects five unsafe template patterns
objective: Proves that the checker raises a problem for: a placeholder secret value, an empty secrets list, an empty secrets section followed by registries, a name-only secret, and a Key Vault secret without an identity. Runs over 5 snippets.
precondition: Offline; text checker for cloud deployment templates, no cloud access.

steps.action: Run the checker on each unsafe snippet.
steps.expected: For each snippet the checker returns at least one problem.

name: Data Analyzer: The safety check accepts four safe template patterns
objective: Proves that the checker does not wrongly flag: no secrets section with secretRef env, Key Vault references with identity, a commented-out secrets example, and volume secrets. Runs over 4 snippets.
precondition: Offline; text checker for cloud deployment templates, no cloud access.

steps.action: Run the checker on each safe snippet.
steps.expected: For each snippet the checker returns no problems.
